title: PhLynx physiology template, written as pieces
description: A template for the physiology view written as the five pieces it is built from: compartments, membranes, tubes, folds and process zones. Dropping it on the view adds copies of its pieces, the workspace's own from then on. Keys this schema does not list are ignored with a warning.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editors. Ignored by PhLynx.

schemaVersion.description: The format version: 4 for a template written as pieces.

id.description: The template's id: a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and hyphens (2-48 characters).

description.description: A sentence or two on what the template shows.

license.description: The template's licence, as an SPDX identifier such as CC0-1.0.

pieces.description: The pieces, each a compartment, membrane, tube, fold or process zone.

pieceId.description: A piece's id, or a span's within its membrane: a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and hyphens (1-32 characters).

compartment.description: A space: standing freely in another compartment or on the view, docked against membrane sides, or filling the membrane that encloses it.

id.description: Its id, unique among the pieces.

parent.description: The compartment it stands in; none for the view itself. A compartment a membrane encloses stands where the membrane does.

frame.description: Where a compartment standing freely is drawn, from the corner of what it stands in. One docked, or filling its membrane, is drawn by them instead.

docks.description: The membrane sides, or folds, it lies against, on their inner face (within the membrane, as a microdomain) or outer face (beside it, as a fluid).

depth.description: How far a docked compartment reaches from its docks, in pixels.

term.description: What annotations call the place, as an ontology term's CURIE (GO:0001750, say).

style.description: Drawn as a vessel: walled along its length, open at its ends.

skin.description: Artwork the piece is drawn with: an SVG skin of the workspace's, by its id.

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece. Pieces offer a site by default.

dock.description: A stretch of a membrane's side, or a fold, that a compartment lies against.

on.description: The membrane, or fold, it lies against.

side.description: The membrane's side; not for a fold.

face.description: The face it lies against: inside (it is within the membrane) or outside (it stands beside it).

from.description: Where along the side the stretch starts, 0 to 1, left to right or top to bottom. Defaults to 0.

to.description: Where it ends, after from. Defaults to 1.

membrane.description: A membrane round the compartments it encloses: a cell's, or an organelle's within a compartment. The one it encloses that is docked to none of its sides fills it.

id.description: Its id, unique among the pieces.

parent.description: The compartment it stands in, as an organelle's does; none for the view.

encloses.description: The compartments it encloses, each standing where it does.

sides.description: Each side's spans: the protein sites along it, side by side. A side not listed is one span, named for the side.

frame.description: Where the membrane is drawn, from the corner of what it stands in, and how big at least.

skin.description: Artwork the piece is drawn with: an SVG skin of the workspace's, by its id.

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece. Pieces offer a site by default.

span.description: A stretch of a membrane's side: a site for membrane proteins.

id.description: Its id, unique within its membrane.

to.description: Where it ends along its side, 0 to 1; it starts where the span before it ends. The last span runs to the end and may leave it out.

annotation.description: The annotated facet this span stands for, so annotated proteins land on it.

group.description: Spans in the same group share the proteins that do not name a side.

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece. Pieces offer a site by default.

tube.description: A connector between two compartments, carrying one flux module.

id.description: Its id, unique among the pieces.

ends.description: The two compartments it joins, upstream first.

flux.description: What it carries: a flow (the default), a gap junction between two cells, a bridge (an open channel of cytoplasm walled by membrane), or diffusion.

bends.description: Its corners, from the view's corner; its way is drawn square through them.

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece. Pieces offer a site by default.

fold.description: An invagination of a membrane, such as a T-tubule: proteins sit down its walls, and its lumen is what lies outside the side it dips in from, or what is docked to its outer face.

id.description: Its id, unique among the pieces.

membrane.description: The membrane it is a fold of.

side.description: The side it dips in from.

at.description: Where along the side, 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.75.

depth.description: Its least depth, in pixels; it is drawn deeper for more proteins.

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece. Pieces offer a site by default.

zone.description: An area in a compartment for process modules.

id.description: Its id, unique among the pieces.

frame.description: Where it is drawn, from its compartment's corner; without one, in a row along its compartment's top.

site.description: Set to false to offer no site on this piece. Pieces offer a site by default.
